raw_record.question_text: In $\odot O$, $\overline{EC}$ and $\overline{AB}$ are diameters, and $\angle BOD \cong \angle DOE \cong \angle EOF \cong \angle FOA$. Find $m\widehat{ACB}$.

method.method_draft: First inspect the diagram: A is on the lower-left of the circle, C is on the lower-right, and B is on the upper-right, so the named arc \(\widehat{ACB}\) is the arc from A to B passing through C along the right/bottom side of the circle. From the text, \(\overline{AB}\) is a diameter of circle \(O\). Therefore A and B are endpoints of a diameter, so any arc with endpoints A and B is a semicircle. Since the diagram confirms C lies on one of the arcs from A to B, \(\widehat{ACB}\) is that semicircle, and its measure is \(180^\circ\).
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：圆心 O 在圆内，A 标在圆的左下方，C 标在右下方，B 标在右上方；图中从 A 到 B 的线段经过 O，是一条直径，C 位于从 A 经下/右侧到 B 的那段圆弧上。推理：题目也给出 AB 是直径，所以 A 和 B 是圆的一对对径点。以直径端点 A、B 为端点的圆弧是半圆；指定的弧 ACB 是经过 C 的那一个半圆，因此 m弧ACB = 180°。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the placement/order of points on the circle: A, C, and B occur along the same arc, so \(\widehat{ACB}\) denotes the A-to-B arc through C.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the given statement that \(\overline{AB}\) is a diameter of \(\odot O\); the equal-angle information is not needed for this route.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: An arc whose endpoints are the endpoints of a diameter is a semicircle, and every semicircle measures \(180^\circ\).
